name: DhanaERP Master Base
description: Master control-plane application bundle for DhanaERP deployments on Frappe v16.

notes: Master-specific application bundle layered on top of dhana-base-v16.
Defines the DT Master control-plane application.
Framework and shared ERP applications are inherited through dhana-base-v16.
Optional capabilities are composed separately by the Master product manifest.
DT Master and DT Tenant remain independent application families.
All applications must pass Frappe v16 compatibility validation before production locking.

applications.name: dt_master
applications.notes: DhanaERP Master control-plane application. Generates, configures and manages tenant sites.
